AGREEMENT FOR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES
Parties to Agreement. Diane Callahan (hereinafter referred to as “Client”) retains Laura T. Pierce, Licensed Educational Psychologist CA #3003, Nationally Certified School Psychologist #34912 (hereinafter referred to as “Specialist”) at 500 Commerce Plaza, Brookfield, CA, to perform Psycho-Educational Assessment regarding Client’s child, Emma Rose Callahan, date of birth  ___________.


Services of Specialist. Specialist agrees to perform Psycho-Educational Assessment and provide a written report as well as consultation to explain and clarify findings. Client may also retain Specialist as an advocate for school-related support. Psycho-educational Assessment is a formal process that collects clinical information from many sources in order to reach a diagnosis, to make a prognosis, to render hypotheses about the person's condition, and to determine instructional and other interventions. Although it includes “tests”, assessment is a broader process that integrates numerous measurements with professional clinical interpretation specific to the child. Assessment may result in diagnoses, but its greater goal is to identify combinations and interactions of strengths and weaknesses in aspects of the child's current functioning that have particular relevance to behavior, relationships, learning and problem-solving (both academically and interpersonally).

The evaluation will provide psycho-educational assessment in order to evaluate your child's current functioning, including, but not limited to, the following areas:
Cognitive and Processing Ability to determine strengths and weakness and identify or rule out the presence of any processing deficits and learning disabilities as well as recommending interventions
Developmental levels and strengths and weaknesses including behavioral, adaptive, social- emotional, cognitive, and communication
*Academic Skills Levels
*Executive Functioning strengths and weaknesses
*The presence of mental health conditions and their observed and potential impact on functioning

Client Provision of Previous Assessment. At their earliest convenience, Client agrees to provide Specialist copies of previous medical records, educational records, and assessments as well as permission to exchange information with the professionals providing services and care to Emma Rose Callahan.

Specialist’s Fees. Client agrees to pay the Specialist’s fees as follows:

A. The estimate for this evaluation is $4500. The rate for the Specialist will be $150 per hour for assessment, observations, interviews, report generation and parent consultation. Client agrees to pay an initial retainer of $2000 on 4/12/25 when assessment will commence.

Billing.
Specialist will provide monthly statements to Client indicating status of the Client’s account. Client may pay a minimum monthly amount of $500 with any additional amounts until the balance has been paid.

Specialist’s statements shall be due and payable upon receipt by Client.

 Any late balances aged upon thirty days shall be subject to finance charges at the periodic rate of one percent (1%) per months (12% annual percentage rate). Client understands that such finance charges are necessary in order to encourage prompt payment and avoid unnecessary large outstanding balances, as well as to offset outlay costs.  


Rights and Responsibilities of Patient and Client

Notice to Clients: The Board of Behavioral Sciences receives and responds to complaints regarding services provided within the scope of practice of licensed educational psychologists. You may contact the board online at www.bbs.ca.gov, or by calling 916-555-0133.

The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) of 1996 is a
U.S. law designed to protect sensitive patient health information from being disclosed without the patient's consent or knowledge. Under HIPAA, you have the right to privacy and security of your health information. You can access and obtain copies of your medical records, request corrections, and know who has accessed your information. Your health information cannot be shared without your consent, except in certain situations required by law. We are committed to protecting your personal health information and ensuring its confidentiality.
Responsibilities: a. Client's responsibilities include providing accurate information and attending scheduled appointments. b. Specialist’s responsibilities include completing evaluation report in a timely manner, adequately explaining results and answering any questions, adherance to ethical guidelines and professional standards set by relevant psychological and educational organizations.


Limitations and Disclaimers
Scope of Assessment: Clarify any limitations of the assessment and that it is not a substitute for medical or psychiatric evaluation.

No Guarantees: This assessment does not guarantee specific outcomes or diagnoses.


I, the undersigned client, have read the entire content of this agreement, fully understand it and agree to each and every provision contained within it. I acknowledge receipt of a copy of this agreement.
